# Skill (OpenAI)

OpenAI says skill in the industry's sense of a [skill][industry.skill]: "A skill packages instructions, resources, and optional scripts so either product can follow a workflow reliably", and "A skill is a directory with a SKILL.md file plus optional scripts and references"; skills "build on the open agent skills standard" ([Build skills][o12]). The initial list of skills is capped at 2% of the context window.

## Examples

- Skills in ChatGPT and Codex, installed directly or in a [plugin][openai.plugin] ([Skills and plugins][o13]).
